confidence_notes: Three web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and two for Seattle prices. Restaurant meal, coffee, beer and cocktail anchors come from crowdsourced indexes (Numbeo via Expatica, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, Cities Insider). Those were mostly 2026 figures, but crowdsourced data is noisy. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation, quoted as US dollars per Australian dollar. No reliable restaurant wine-by-the-glass figure was found, so wine is estimated from the local beer and cocktail price relationship. The midrange two-person meal is estimated from the inexpensive-meal level and the roughly 24% Seattle restaurant premium. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings, and summer-season rates are volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seattle is a high-cost West Coast US city, comparable to Portland and San Francisco, but with somewhat lower prices than San Francisco. Restaurant prices run about 24% above the US average, based on MyLifeElsewhere.
